name: code-visor
description: Code Visor for Claude, a HUD above the Claude Code prompt: model, prompt-cache countdown and context fill, a live progress bar while subagents run, and an agents panel with cost, tokens and time per subagent.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he pick one (Hebrew is laid out right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel automatically
autoOpen.description: subagent: when the first subagent of a session starts; session: when a session starts; off: only with /agents-info
